title: Uniqueness part
statement: For schemes U,V, v : V ⟶ U and E, any morphism satisfying the canonical-section equations is uniquely determined by those equations.

source.place: Modules on Sites, Section 18.43 (Tag 093I, sites-modules-section-constant) and Lemma 093R (sites-modules-lemma-pullback-locally-constant), whose omitted proof is this identification; with Sites, Example 0H7J (sites-example-constant-sheaf), the universal property of the constant sheaf, and the adjunction $v^{-1}\dashv v_*$

proof.text: Apply the representation of constant sheaves by indexed coproducts, inverse-image representability, and the base-change coproduct isomorphism; verify the canonical-section equations and the isomorphism property.

split_report.summary: Split the inverse-image statement through the existing representation of a constant sheaf by the coproduct of copies of the base, the existing inverse-image formula for representable etale sheaves, and a new statement-only node distributing an arbitrary indexed coproduct over base change. The canonical-section condition is tracked through the unit and composition compatibilities of etale inverse images; uniqueness follows from the sheafification universal property and the same representable identifications.
split_report.blueprint: The steps realize the paragraph beginning 'The base Y_(ybar) is strictly henselian local' in lemma-weil-pbc-proper-underived-exchange: pullback of the constant sheaf on the base and naturality of its canonical sections.
